title: Automated Alpco Human Insulin ELISA Protocol
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Transfer standards, controls, samples
steps.instruction: Transfer 25 µL of each standard and control into column 1 of the destination plate(s), then transfer 25 µL of each sample into two columns for each sample column.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 µL standards and controls to column 1
Add 25 µL samples to two columns per sample column

steps.title: Add detection antibody
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of detection antibody to each well of the destination plate.

steps.title: Incubate 1 hour on shaker
steps.instruction: Remove the plate from the OT‑2, place it on a shaker, and incubate for 1 hour.

steps.title: Add TMB substrate
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of TMB substrate to each well of the destination plate.

steps.title: Incubate 15 min on shaker
steps.instruction: Remove the plate from the OT‑2, place it on a shaker, and incubate for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Add stop solution
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of stop solution to each well of the destination plate.
